notes: Trigger-optimization eval set. should_trigger=true => the pm skill should be invoked; false => a near-miss that shares keywords (plan/init/scaffold/execute/groom/epic/story/dashboard/PM) but must NOT trigger. 'queries' is the base set (easy near-misses); 'hard_queries' are adversarial cases that reuse the skill's own literal trigger phrases (I'm the pm, groom the backlog, act as project manager, update status fields, worktree, scaffold the epic) in generic/non-pm-tree contexts to probe over-triggering.
